dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Sarcasm aside, it's actually pretty ironic that Dogecoin, a cryptocurrency created as a joke, is now being offered as a legitimate payment method. It just goes to show that anything can happen in the world of cryptocurrency, even if it doesn't make a whole lot of sense.

Musk’s own involvement in cryptocurrencies (e.g., Bitcoin, Dogecoin) signals his interest in alternative financial systems. If Musk’s cryptocurrency advocacy grows, it could, over the long term, promote alternatives to the dollar.
